description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {0} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pact of the Titan without paying its mana cost.

Resolve Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.When the Giant enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage equal to the Giant's power to any target.
